<thought>To find the HWE template, I will search the template catalog using acrylic acid (C=CC(=O)O) as the product and specify the bond changes in the required format: formation of a C‑C bond (“6-6”), cleavage of C‑P (“6-15”) and C‑O (“6-8”) bonds, and an increase in bond order for a C‑C bond from single to double (“6-6 (1.0->2.0)”).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=CC(=O)O",
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-15", "6-8"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (1.0->2.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
